text:
Samir: Anyone seeing the dashboard charts freezing after today's push? /dashboard/usage on Chrome. Charts hang for ~1-2s when switching time range. TTI up ~1s.

Jia: Yup. Flamecharts show main thread blocked in MetricChart.render -> drawHeatmap loop. Also memory spike — heap grows ~30MB then GC.

Priya: We shipped heatmap v3.2.0 earlier which switched to canvas + synchronous layout logic. Bundle +120KB. Could be related.

Marco: Measured network: initial JS gz +250KB; also endpoints returning full series for each chart -> 6 identical requests in parallel when dashboard loads. We lost request coalescing in the refactor.

Olivia: Telemetry shows prefix cache miss rate jumped from 4% -> 73% after deploy. That would cause mass refetches and subsequent re-renders.

Samir: Interesting. Any console errors? I saw `Invariant: seriesId missing` from ChartDataProvider around the spike.

Jia: Console snippet: 
```
Error: Invariant: seriesId missing
    at ChartDataProvider.getSeries (ChartDataProvider.js:84)
    at MetricChart.update (MetricChart.js:210)
```
Also dozens of identical `/api/metrics?range=...` calls.

Priya: Quick repro: toggle to 90d range -> each chart issues a full fetch. Previously we used `/metrics/batch`. Looks like the batch call got removed in the refactor to the new data layer.

Marco: Filed Sentry: ENG-UI-4123. I'll instrument request coalescing and add per-chart fetch counts to telemetry. Quick mitigation options: revert heatmap change OR reintroduce batch endpoint.

Olivia: :thumbsup: I can temporarily bump prefix cache TTL to 5m to reduce immediate churn while we patch.

Samir: Can we hotfix today? If we rollback, what's the impact on Dedicated customers who've pinned the new runtime?

Priya: Rollback will remove v3 heatmap and restore the batch endpoint. Should be low risk for hosted. For Dedicated, we need to coordinate — but we can disable the feature flag for them.

Priya: Deploy-bot: starting rollback now (patch + revert heatmap lib).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deploy 1722334 by Priya. ETA ~6m.

Jia: I'll add a defensive guard to ChartDataProvider to avoid full re-render when seriesId is missing and wire in a cheap coalesce wrapper: 
```
const coalesce = createCoalescer('/api/metrics');
coalesce.enqueue(req);
```
That should reduce parallel identical requests immediately.

Marco: Proposed plan: 1) rollback now; 2) reintroduce batching + request coalescing; 3) add telemetry for per-chart fetch counts and cache-hit ratios; 4) RFC to move heavy heatmap math to a worker off main thread.

Olivia: Filed perf alert card and assigned to @Priya and @Marco.

Samir: Thanks — monitor for 30m. If rollback doesn't reduce TTI by >500ms, escalate to page oncall. I'll check Sentry and the telemetry dashboard.

Priya: Noted. I'll post update in this thread when rollback completes and when we ship the coalescing patch.

Marco: Quick note: add a unit test to ensure the batch endpoint is exercised by the data layer to avoid regressions next time.

Samir: Sounds good. Postmortem if needed. Appreciate the quick jump.
